name: SCG Decor Public Company Limited
summary: SCG Decor Public Company Limited, through its subsidiaries, produces and distributes ceramic tiles, sanitary ware, and other related products and services in Thailand, Vietnam, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Decor Surfaces Business and Bathroom Business. It offers faucets and fittings, porcelain tiles, floor and wall tiles, tile adhesive, and grout products. The company also provides stone vinyl and plastic composite products, and vinyl tile products. It provides its products under the Italia Espana, COTTO, CAMPANA, SOSUCO, LT by COTTO, Prema, Prime, Premier, MARIWASA, Luxuria PORCLELAIN TILES, KIA, and Impresso CERAMICS brands.
